rawRecord.short_description: Enables AI agents to send and receive WeChat messages through QR code authentication and long-polling message retrieval.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates WeChat messaging capabilities into AI agents through a bot server that handles QR code login, message polling, text sending, and typing indicators. Supports long-polling for real-time message reception (up to 7 days), state persistence across restarts, and terminal/PNG/URL QR code generation. Works independently without requiring the OpenClaw framework.
